name: boxline
description: Cloud browsers, shells and web search for your agent: open real pages in an isolated browser, read and act on them, search the web, and run code in a clean sandbox.

interface.shortDescription: Real browsers and sandboxes in the cloud
interface.longDescription: Boxline gives your conversations an isolated cloud machine with a real Chrome browser, a shell and a disk. Search the web, crawl a site, pull structured data out of pages, open and read pages as a browser renders them, click and type on them, take screenshots, and run code and shell commands in a clean sandbox with its own disk. Sign in with your Boxline account; every machine is yours alone and stops when you are done.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for the latest Node.js release and summarize what changed, with links
Crawl the docs at docs.python.org/3/tutorial and list every page with a one-line summary
Get the plan names and monthly prices from these three pricing pages as a table
Run this Python snippet in a clean sandbox and tell me what it prints
